title: A decision that includes you both

captions.physics: Choosing through agreement with each other
captions.emotions: Feeling the choice form a whole

meaning: A shared choice feels complete when differing wishes belong within one decision and remain free to change over time.
text: A good decision can feel like a complete picture in which nobody has been left outside the frame. The Lovers in the physical position of Manipura appear through discussion and a choice that considers you both. The Lovers in energy show the motive, preserving willing unity and acting from mutual interest. The World in emotions brings a sense of wholeness: the decision connects different parts of your lives and lets you move forward calmly. The repeated Lovers distinguish how you reach agreement from your wish to remain open to each other within it.

Imagine planning a trip together. There is room for a walk one person has wanted and a museum that interests the other, with free time between them. **A complete choice can accommodate different wishes.** You need not enjoy every item equally for the trip to belong to you both. What matters is joint participation in the route and freedom to adjust it once distances and timings become clearer.

The difficulty is expecting the agreement you found to be perfectly final. A new request then seems to break the whole: surely everything was settled already. Closing discussion promises to preserve that pleasing sense of completion. Living agreement also includes hearing a changed wish. Your plan remains whole after an adjustment if both people still recognise their free choice and continue to participate in deciding.
